reason: A dsh plugin that provides native tools for searching, storing, deleting, and checking the health of an agentmemory persistent-memory REST service.

summaries.zh: 将 dsh 连接到 agentmemory REST 服务，为智能体提供搜索、保存、删除持久记忆及检查服务健康状态的工具。
summaries.en: Connects dsh to an agentmemory REST service and provides tools for searching, storing, deleting, and checking the health of persistent memories.

capabilities: Connects to a configurable local or remote agentmemory REST API
Searches stored memories using semantic and keyword queries
Stores durable memories with metadata and optional expiration
Deletes memories by memory ID or session ID
Reads a health endpoint and uses bearer-token authentication
